title: California Insurance Code Section 10167.5 (notice when a nonforfeiture benefit is implemented on default)
updateCadence: Amended only by legislation. The section credit on the official host at the time of access read Added by Stats. 1990, Ch. 670, Sec. 1.
claims: Section 10167.5(a) provides that whenever a nonforfeiture benefit is implemented by a life insurer in connection with a defaulting policyowner, the insurer shall provide a notice to the policyowner which explains that action and refers the policyowner to the other available options, if any, under the provisions of the policy.
Section 10167.5(b) requires the notice to be in writing and mailed to the last known address of the policyowner shown on the records of the insurer.
Section 10167.5(c) provides that the section does not apply to reinsurance, group insurance, pure endowment, annuity or reversionary annuity contracts, or industrial insurance.
